title: Display Challenge reference solution
explanation: Inline-block allows compact labels to keep padding and dimensions. flow-root establishes a block formatting context for the stack; the sibling selector adds consistent spacing between adjacent children.
manual_validation_checklist: Paste the CSS into the stylesheet used by the starter HTML.
Inspect the targeted element and computed styles in browser developer tools.
Check keyboard focus and at least a narrow and a wide viewport where relevant.
Confirm the required CSS evidence is present; string checks alone do not prove rendered correctness.
